Tax Law

Erasmus University Rotterdam

← Back to search
About this programme

UCR currently cannot construct a sufficiently close programme for a meaningful curriculum comparison.

Tax Law at Erasmus University Rotterdam studies how tax rules operate and how lawyers interpret and apply them. It combines Dutch, European and international taxation with public and private law, company law, accounting, public finance, legal skills and research.

UCR offers law, accounting and public economics, including the economic effects of taxation. These courses support related study, but they do not provide a sustained programme in the interpretation and application of tax law. We therefore show Erasmus’s complete curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Full-time; mainly Dutch-taught

The 15-EC minor is subject to access and approval rules. The 10-EC third-year legal-academic skills component includes the bachelor thesis.
